smallest_substitute_proof_obligations: Reconstruct or produce the exact accepted V554 F1 semantic parent before route derivation.
Enforce exactly-one-F1-per-route and no multi-F1 synthesis.
Apply the exact immutable ADP-002 authority/rule/version and route-shape match.
Preserve exact source, structural channel/mediation locus and receiver bindings without descriptive/fuzzy repair.
Produce the same canonical V555 route identity tuple and deterministic interpretation.
Preserve route ordering source -> mediation locus -> receiver and structural-direction non-reconstruction law.
Preserve typed positive, valid-empty, denied, missing-authority, unresolved-identity, deferred and integrity-failure distinctions.
Reference inherited V554 F2 exactly; do not duplicate its semantics as V555 conditions.
Preserve ADP-003 valid-empty registry and route-born-only ownership/evaluator law.
Preserve exact producer/authority provenance closure while allowing transitive rather than copied ancestor payload.
Expose the exact route as V556 canonical base edge; forbid V556 re-identification or adjacency/co-resolution inference.
Preserve actor-independent ceiling: no encounter, traversal, realization, response, belief, relationship history, biography or psyche.
Demonstrate equality at semantic object, identity, typed-state, consumer and replay levels, not merely rowset or final aggregate output equality.
strongest_bypass_argument: A separate V555 physical stage could be removable in principle if an integrated/recomputed path first establishes the exact V554 F1 and then deterministically produces the identical governed V555 route object/reference semantics before every consumer, while preserving the exact authority/replay graph. R02 shows copied provenance joins are not themselves a reason to retain the stage.
strongest_retain_argument: V555 is the first accepted owner of the atomic mediator/channel/receiver route relation. V554 does not contain that ordered route meaning, and V556 is expressly forbidden to manufacture or re-identify the participant base edge. Therefore any proposal that simply deletes the V555 semantic object, substitutes admission/query lineage, or lets V556 infer routes is semantically invalid under current authority.
